title: Family Dollar Recalls Wax Warmers Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The wax warmers can produce high flames, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 32,000.

title: Laceration Injuries Prompt SharkNinja to Recall Ninja BL660 Blenders to Provide New Warnings and Instructions
summary: The blender poses a laceration risk if consumers pour or invert the pitcher after removing the lid while the loose stacked blade assembly is still inside the pitcher. Units: About 1.1 million (an additional 99,000 were sold in Canada).

title: Mahindra USA Recalls Compact Tractors Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Fuel lines can break or leak, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 2,000 (in addition to about 100 in Canada).

title: PNY Recalls Portable Lithium Polymer Battery Packs Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Batteries can overheat and vent flames, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 56,000 (in addition, about 800 sold in Canada).

title: STIHL Recalls Edgers, Trimmer/Brushcutters, Pole Pruners and KombiMotors Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The gasoline tank vent can become dislodged due to incorrect factory installation and cause fuel to leak, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 140,000 (in addition, about 16,000 were sold in Canada).

title: WakaWaka Recalls Adapter Kits Due to Electrical Shock, Explosion, Fire Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The Adapter Kit can overheat posing a risk of fire, and the plastic shell of the adapter can open exposing a risk of shock to consumers. Units: About 700 (In addition, 200 units were sold in Canada).

title: Belle Investment Recalls Richie House Boys' Jackets Due to Entanglement Hazard
summary: The jackets have drawstrings in the hood and at the bottom, which pose an entrapment hazard to children. title: FontanaArte Recalls Sonmi Light Fixtures Due to Risk of Injury
summary: The glass shade disc on the light fixture can detach and fall, posing a risk of injury from impact. In addition, broken glass can pose a laceration hazard. Units: About 110 units.

title: Ignite Recalls Kids Straw Tumblers Due to Risk of Ingestion
summary: If a child chews on the drinking straw, small pieces can break off into the child's mouth, posing a risk of ingestion or aspiration of the small part. Units: About 130,000.

title: Fireworks Over America Recalls Space Monkey Multi-effect Fireworks Due to Burn, Fire, Impact Hazards
summary: The lit firework can tip over and fire shells at bystanders posing burn, fire and impact hazards to consumers. Units: About 36,500.

title: Club Car Recalls Gas Golf and Transport Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: An improperly factory-installed hose clamp can rub and wear a hole in the fuel tank, causing a leak and posing a fire hazard. Units: About 11,600.

title: T3 Recalls Twirl 360 Curling Irons Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The clamp can detach while in use, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 8,400 (in addition, about 800 were sold in Canada).

title: GE Recalls Air Conditioning and Heating Units Due to Risk of Fire
summary: Moisture from outdoor air can accumulate near the unit's heater when the unit is operated with the vent door continuously open. This, along with two shorted electrical components, can create an electrical ground path and arcing, posing a risk of fire. Units: About 33,500.

title: Window Shades Recalled by Carra Imports Due to Strangulation Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Cellular, Roller and Soft Horizontal Shades: Strangulation can occur when the shade's continuous loop pull cord or bead chain is not attached to the wall with a tension device and a child's neck becomes entangled in the free-standing loop. title: BRP Recalls Snowmobiles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Internal damage to the fuel hose can cause a leak, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 2,800.

title: CocoaVia Brand Frothers Recalled by Mars Symbioscience Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The spring on the end of the frothers can detach from the metal wand, posing ingestion and choking hazards. Units: About 5,000.

title: Exmark Recalls Quest Riding Mowers Due to a Fire Hazard
summary: The fuel filters on the mowers can become brittle and fractured, allowing fuel to leak and posing a fire hazard. Units: About 500 (in addition, about six were sold in Canada).

title: Lutron Electronics Recalls Roman Shades Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: Strangulations can occur when a child places his/her neck between the exposed ribbon (hobble tape) and the fabric on the backside of the shade or when a child pulls the tape out and wraps it around his/her neck. Units: About 240 in United States.

title: MVP Group Recalls Glass Jar Candles Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The glass lid can break when the jar is being opened, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 720,000.

title: SalesOne Recalls Light Up Ear Plug Jewelry Due to Burn Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Spencer Gifts
summary: Battery acid can leak from ear plug jewelry's battery, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 8,400.

title: Toro Recalls TimeCutter Riding Mowers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The fuel filters on the mowers can become brittle and fractured, allowing fuel to leak and posing a fire hazard. Units: About 8,600 (in addition, about 400 were sold in Canada).

title: Bostitch Electric Pencil Sharpeners Recalled by Amax Due to Shock Hazard
summary: The electric components inside can energize the pencil sharpener, posing a shock hazard. Units: About 44,000.

title: Kona Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The bicycle fork can crack or break, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 530.

title: PetSmart Expands Recall of Fish Bowls Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The glass fish bowls can crack, shatter or break during normal handling, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 81,300 in the U.S. and 4,000 in Canada (an additional 10,200 were recalled in the U.S. on April 24, 2014 and 1,000 were previously recalled in Canada).

title: PetSmart Recalls Top Fin Betta Bowl Kits Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The glass bowl can crack, shatter or break during normal handling, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 148,000 (in addition, about 8,000 sold in Canada).

title: REI Recalls Outdoor Rocker Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The chair can tip backwards while rocking, posing a fall hazard to the user. Units: About 30,500.
